channel.title: Burkina Faso - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burkina Faso, every source cited.

item.title: Burkina Faso launches digital university research project
item.description: The four-year Digit OACS project, funded by Germany, will analyze digital practices in universities across Burkina Faso, Kenya, and Nigeria.

item.title: Burkina Faso launches LAAFIAKO health complaint platform
item.description: The digital tool allows citizens to submit complaints, claims, suggestions, and information requests to health services.

item.title: Burkina Faso army marks 66 years amid anti-terror fight
item.description: Minister Célestin Simporé stated that the army has gained the upper hand against terrorists.
